subject: Namazu

subject: Nandi bear

subject: Nang Ta-khian

subject: Nargun

subject: Nariphon

subject: Nasnas

subject: Nav (Slavic folklore)

subject: Negret

subject: Nekomata

subject: Nemean lion

subject: Night hag

subject: Nightmarchers

subject: Ningyo

subject: Ninki Nanka

subject: Nisse (folklore)

subject: Nivatakavacha

subject: Nixie (folklore)

subject: Nue

subject: Nuku-mai-tore

subject: Nuno sa punso

subject: Nure-onna

subject: Nurikabe

subject: Nymph

subject: Nāga

subject: Obake

subject: Obia (folklore)

subject: Oceanids

subject: Odei

subject: Og

subject: Ogre

subject: Ojáncanu

subject: Oni

subject: Onocentaur

subject: Oozlum bird

subject: Otso

subject: Ovinnik

subject: Owlman

subject: Paasselkä devils

subject: Pamola

subject: Pandi (legendary creature)

subject: Panotti

subject: Pard

subject: Patagons

subject: Pech (mythology)

subject: Pegasus

subject: Pelesit

subject: Penanggalan

subject: Penghou

subject: Pesanta

subject: Phoenix (mythology)

subject: Pillan

subject: Piru (spirit)

subject: Pixie

subject: Pixiu

subject: Plague Maiden

subject: Polong

subject: Ponaturi

subject: Pop (ghost)

subject: Poroniec

subject: Poubi Lai

subject: Pouākai

subject: Povitrulya

subject: Preta

subject: Psychai

subject: Puck (folklore)

subject: Pukwudgie

subject: Pygmy (Greek mythology)

subject: Python (mythology)

subject: Qutrub

subject: Rabisu

subject: Rain Bird (legend)

subject: Rainbow crow

subject: Rainbow Serpent

subject: Ramidreju

subject: Rangda

subject: Raróg

subject: Re'em

subject: Redcap

subject: Reptilian humanoid

subject: Rübezahl

subject: Saci (folklore)

subject: Sack Man

subject: Sandman

subject: Santa Claus

subject: Sarimanok

subject: Sasabonsam

subject: Satan

subject: Satyr

subject: Sayona

subject: Sazae-oni
text: Sazae-oni are creatures from Japanese mythology, resembling large mollusks.

subject: Schrat

subject: Scitalis

subject: Scorpion man

subject: Scylla

subject: Sea serpent
text: A sea serpent is a type of sea monster described in various mythologies and religious texts.

subject: Selkie

subject: Seps (legendary creature)

subject: Shade (mythology)

subject: Shadow person

subject: Shahbaz (bird)

subject: Shedim

tradition: English, Scottish and German, as schellenrocc

subject: Shen (clam-monster)

subject: Shikigami

subject: Shinigami

subject: Sigbin

subject: Silenus

subject: Simonside Dwarfs

subject: Simurgh

subject: Singa (mythology)

subject: Siren (mythology)

subject: Skrzak

subject: Sleipnir

subject: Slender Man

subject: Snow Lion

subject: Sphinx
